body:
EnforcementManager.java's scheduleHumanReaction(): each Enforcement zombie's target-acquisition is now gaussian-jittered (base 10 ticks/0.5s, sigma 30%, PARENA-compiled generated.HumannessFingerprint.enforcementReactionDelayTicks) with a real, bounded 15% hesitation chance (0-40 tick bonus) instead of instant, uniform setTarget() in the same spawn tick. Logged per-mob via the plugin's own logger. Full mvn package (JDK 25) verified green end to end. Commit 71f5450/b3e66dc.

⚓ ☃
title: Real Enforcement 'humanness fingerprint' shipped -- organic reaction delay, verified mvn build
